local.title: CLI setup
local.purpose: Select the local CLI context, load shell completion and identify the CLI build.

shell.title: Interactive shell
shell.purpose: Select a service context, explicitly connect tenant metadata and storage, and run operations in one interactive session.

env.title: Process environment
env.purpose: Inspect and compare process, Go runtime, host and build information.

cluster.title: Cluster & node status
cluster.purpose: Inspect membership, reachability, health, gossip and node drain lifecycle.

k8s.title: Kubernetes helpers
k8s.purpose: Check kubectl prerequisites and plan or execute Kubernetes status, logs and scaling actions.

config.title: Server configuration
config.purpose: Inspect server configuration and compare configuration drift across nodes.

logging.title: Runtime log levels
logging.purpose: Read or temporarily change server logging levels.

profile.title: Profiles & trace
profile.purpose: Collect CPU, memory, goroutine, mutex and execution-trace diagnostics.

ops.title: In-flight operations
ops.purpose: Inspect running operations, their age and operation-registry pressure.

metrics.title: Metrics & scenarios
metrics.purpose: Inspect Prometheus samples, trends and supported scenario findings.

diagnosis.title: Native diagnosis
diagnosis.purpose: Diagnose WP append stalls, writer buffer/flush buildup, configured disk admission and explicitly scoped replica lag with bounded native evidence. External monitoring and Milvus diagnosis are separate tools.

logstore.title: Writer runtime
logstore.purpose: Inspect loaded writers, buffers, flush queues and LAC; perform targeted flush, compact or fence actions.

instance.title: Local data inventory
instance.purpose: List bucket/root instances holding node-local data before drain or reclamation.

log.title: Log progress & retention
log.purpose: Inspect reader progress and coverage, manage verified skip ranges, and advance checkpoint-backed retention.

segment.title: Segment diagnosis
segment.purpose: Probe actual entry reads and inspect local blocks to locate damage on each quorum member.

meta.title: Metadata inspection & repair
meta.purpose: Read decoded coordinator records, check metadata constraints, export snapshots and apply reviewed corrections.

marking.title: Compacted-mark distribution
marking.purpose: Inspect notification records and settle verified manual mark-distribution cases.

etcd.title: Raw etcd exploration
etcd.purpose: Discover namespaces and inspect exact raw keys, revisions and values without writing etcd.
